title: Pharaoh Djoser (Netjerikhet)
kingdom: Old Kingdom of Egypt (Age of the Pyramids)
biography: Second pharaoh of the Third Dynasty who commissioned royal architect Imhotep to construct the world's first colossal stone building: the Step Pyramid of Saqqara.
internationalConnections: Organized major mining expeditions to the Sinai peninsula for turquoise and copper.
